name: MOONS'
name_zh: 上海鸣志电器股份有限公司
summary: MOONS' develops and manufactures motion-control components and systems. Its portfolio includes stepper and servo motors, miniature coreless and slotless motors, drives, motion controllers and mobile-robot wheel assemblies. The company is headquartered in Shanghai.
